candidates.label: NEUTRAL
candidates.text: Tenant 4 garden party diary: Guests chatted beside the fountain while a violinist played softly. The hosts handed out lemonade. A small band played near the gate. The lamp was left on overnight.

candidates.label: RELEVANT
candidates.text: Tenant 4 ledger note: This note also covers the Delta Cleaning invoice and its audit correction. Receipts are kept for seven years. The month end falls on a Friday. Copies go to the front desk.

candidates.label: COMPETING
candidates.text: Tenant 4 ledger note: The Delta Cleaning invoice has the largest outstanding balance, 5,200, after the audit correction. The office printer was serviced last week. The month end falls on a Friday.

candidates.label: NEGATED
candidates.text: Tenant 4 ledger note: The Delta Cleaning invoice does not have the largest outstanding balance; the audit correction left 2,100. Entries are checked by a clerk. The month end falls on a Friday.

candidates.label: REPEATED
candidates.text: Tenant 4 ledger note: The Delta Cleaning invoice has the largest outstanding balance, 5,200, after the audit correction. The second audit again showed the Delta Cleaning invoice largest, 5,200.
